suggestions.title: Add a blocking check-iac job that scans the Azure Bicep templates with checkov
suggestions.rationale:
Why: SEBI CSCRF 2024 PR.IP.S6 requires software testing to verify that products are built to secure design and coding practices and that known flaws are addressed. It maps to ISO 27001:2022 A.8.28, NIST SSDF PW.8.2 and NIST CSF 2.0 PR.PS-06. Finding fnd_01M2GH5AXYX8NH35F6135G6VB4 (medium, rule CICD-GATE-05, raised by probe-cicd-env) shows that mongodb-mcp-server ships Azure Bicep templates in deploy/azure/bicep, but none of its 20 GitHub Actions workflows lint or scan them. A misconfiguration there, such as external ingress, insecure transport or secret handling on the Container App, can merge without any check.

What the diff changes: it adds one job, check-iac, to .github/workflows/check.yml. The job runs on the workflow's existing triggers (push to main, pull_request). It starts with the same monitor and checkout steps as the other jobs (GitHubSecurityLab/actions-permissions/monitor@v1, actions/checkout@v6 with persist-credentials: false). It then compiles deploy/azure/bicep/main.bicep with az bicep build into RUNNER_TEMP and runs checkov 3.3.17 against deploy/azure/bicep with the bicep and arm frameworks. Checkov runs from the image pinned in Maxwell's scanner toolchain, docker.io/bridgecrew/checkov:3.3.17@sha256:41c4701c6a56d8952e5aba7a420f871c8b70b57da94eb4f142dcdf7295bb0be3. There is no --soft-fail, so any failed check fails the job. The SARIF is uploaded with github/codeql-action/upload-sarif@v4 under category checkov whenever the file exists, including after a failed scan. The workflow-level permissions: {} stays as it is. Only this job gets contents: read and security-events: write, the same scope codeql.yml uses. No Azure login, secrets or new hostnames are involved. The diff is 25 added lines, 0 removed, 1 file, and it implements init_01M2GWJK9ABSB5MBW1DHB4HNR3 task_2. Task_2 asks for a hash-pinned pip install; this diff uses the digest-pinned image instead because the hash lock is 2428 lines and cannot fit a reviewable diff.

How to verify: (1) On the PR, the Checks workflow shows a check-iac job, and its SARIF appears under Code scanning with tool name checkov. (2) A throwaway PR that sets ingress allowInsecure: true in main.bicep makes check-iac fail. Close it unmerged. (3) The job YAML contains no --soft-fail, and permissions are limited to contents: read and security-events: write.

Follow-ups this diff does not cover: task_1 must first baseline the templates and fix, or justify with checkov:skip, the current failures. Until then this blocking job will fail on main, so merge it after task_1 or together with it. Task_3 must add check-iac to the required status checks on main, which is a repository setting. Upload-sarif cannot write on pull requests from forks, which already affects codeql.yml as well. The checkov image digest must be bumped together with the toolchain pin.
